Summary
: This is a summary edition of the English translation of the Mahabharata—one of the largest epics ever written. The eighteen books contain roughly 100,000 Sanskrit verses. It deals with the legendary history of ancient India and contains a large number of tales and sub-narratives interwoven in the text.
